description: The comparison matrix (PLAN.md, Parity harness). widths: one width per breakpoint band. fast: the agents' reduction. theme_routes: the routes that also run the data-theme legs (theme-light, theme-dark), the kitchen-sink equivalent. theme_storage: how a data-theme leg sets data-theme on <html>: the harness stores the theme in this localStorage key (JSON) before the load, and the page's own script applies it (PLAN.md Decision 14).
theme_routes_why: The landing page (hero, typing demo, features, comparison); the docs shell with Quick start; text, headings and code; every button variant; tables; form controls with validation states; dropdowns and nav menus; one themed color route. Together they hold every color-bearing element kind the site uses.
